title: re-entrant use-after-free in itertools.groupby
live_proof: back-patched into the 3.13 branch after v3.13.7; the backport is the proof
object: the user's key object, held borrowed in gbo->tgtkey and gbo->currkey
size_class: small object struct, well under the 512-byte pymalloc threshold
lifetime_ender: last reference dropped by a re-entrant __eq__, freeing the object to its pool

native-detect.requires: valgrind, or a --without-pymalloc build for ASan
